name: immich-mcp
description: FastMCP 2.10 server for Immich photo management with AI-powered photo organization and search capabilities.
author: sandraschi

photo_management: Organize my vacation photos from last summer into albums by location and events.
Find all photos of my dog playing in the park and create a highlight reel.
Show me all photos with blue skies and sunny weather from my hiking trips.
Create a timeline of my child's first year using monthly photo highlights.
Find all duplicate photos in my library and help me remove the lower quality ones.
Show me my best landscape photos based on composition and quality.
Find all photos with specific people in them from the past year.
Create a photo book of my top 100 travel photos from the last 5 years.
Find all photos with text in them (like signs or documents).
Show me photos with specific objects (e.g., mountains, beaches, food).
ai_enhancement: Enhance the colors and lighting in my sunset photos.
Remove red-eye from all my portrait photos.
Apply a vintage film filter to my street photography.
Upscale my old family photos to higher resolution.
Colorize my black and white photos.
Remove unwanted objects from the background of my photos.
Create a panorama from these overlapping landscape shots.
Generate a short video slideshow with music from these vacation photos.
Find and fix underexposed or overexposed photos.
Create a time-lapse sequence from these time-stamped photos.
search_queries: Find photos taken in Vienna during Christmas time.
Show me all photos with multiple people smiling.
Find photos with specific color schemes (e.g., blue and white).
Show me photos taken at night with good lighting.
Find all photos with pets in them.
Show me photos from indoor events with good lighting.
Find photos with specific weather conditions (rain, snow, fog).
Show me photos taken at specific landmarks or locations.
Find photos with specific camera settings (e.g., long exposure).
Show me photos from specific months across different years.
organization: Create albums based on the location data in my photos.
Group photos by events using date and time information.
Tag all photos with recognized faces automatically.
Create a folder structure by year and month for all my photos.
Find and organize all screenshots into a separate album.
Create smart albums for photos with specific criteria.
Group similar photos together for easier selection.
Create a 'Best of' collection for each year.
Organize photos by the dominant colors in them.
Create a map view of all my geotagged photos.
sharing: Create a shared album of our family vacation for relatives.
Generate a PDF photo book of my best landscape photos.
Create a private online gallery for my portfolio.
Make a slideshow with music for the family reunion.
Share a selection of photos via a secure link that expires in 7 days.
Create a video montage of my child's first steps.
Generate social media ready versions of these photos.
Create a before/after comparison of edited photos.
Share a selection of photos with specific people tagged.
Create a shared workspace for collaborative photo editing.
